mechanism: Both drugs have anticholinergic properties and CNS depressant effects; fluphenazine may inhibit loperamide metabolism via CYP3A4/CYP2D6, increasing loperamide levels and toxicity risk.
action: Monitor for increased loperamide side effects (CNS depression, constipation, urinary retention); consider dose adjustment or alternative antidiarrheal if excessive anticholinergic effects occur.
